name: Managing Technology Platforms
description: This course examines the strategic, economic, and governance challenges of managing technology platforms in the digital economy. It covers network effects, multi-sided markets, pricing strategies, platform architecture, and ecosystem governance. Students analyze platform growth, competitive dynamics, monetization models, and regulatory risks. Through case-based discussions and strategy design exercises, the course develops the ability to evaluate and manage platform ecosystems. Emphasis is placed on balancing openness and control, incentivizing complementors, and sustaining competitive advantage in digitally mediated markets. The course equips students to apply platform strategy frameworks to real-world digital businesses and emerging technology ecosystems.
